result:
All checks pass: typecheck, lint, the pulls unit test, and i18n consistency. Per instructions, I will not push or commit.

Summary of changes:
- Added a pure `labelToggle(id, number, label, on)` helper in `desktop/src/renderer/lib/pulls.ts`, with a unit test in `pulls.test.ts`.
- `PullRequestsPanel.tsx`: `toggleLabel` now builds its edit via `labelToggle`; each label pill (list view) got a hover/focus-revealed X button (`aria-label` from the new `memory.pulls.labels.remove` key) that calls the same `onToggle(label, false)` path the picker uses; clicks stay inside the labels container so the row's open-modal handler never fires.
- `PullRequestModal.tsx`: the label chips now take `edits`/`onToggleLabel` props, compute their list with `withEdits` (so pending edits show immediately there too), and each chip got the same X button/behavior.
- The label-edit mutation's `onSuccess` now also updates the `['pull', project, number]` detail cache, so once an edit settles, the modal doesn't show the removed label reappearing.
- Added `memory.pulls.labels.remove` to both `en-US.ts` and `pt-BR.ts`.
